name: BLOODWORK: the Gray Zone Underground Combat Circuit
description: The oldest and most notorious underground fighting circuit in the Gray Zone, BLOODWORK runs rotating venues through abandoned infrastructure in the lower Stack, with no weight classes, no augmentation limits, and no medical staff beyond whoever the fighters bring themselves. Matches are announced through encrypted pirate-feed channels forty-eight hours in advance, entry is cash-only in physical Quanta chips, and the crowd is standing-room in drainage corridors and decommissioned processing floors. Some fighters are chrome-heavy mercenaries burning off contract months; others are unaugmented the Gray Zone residents fighting for purse money that represents six months of synth-protein.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 trauma surgeon begins volunteering at BLOODWORK venues under a false identity and discovers the circuit is being used as a testing ground for experimental combat augments by a corponation subsidiary.

A BLOODWORK veteran fighter is offered a legitimate IRONWALL League contract — the first the Gray Zone-origin player in a decade — and must decide whether to trust the system that ignored her for twenty years.
A pirate-feed operator broadcasting BLOODWORK matches receives an anonymous data package that links a series of fighter deaths over five years to a single chrome supplier running defective units.
